<!doctype html>
<html lang="en" data-lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover,interactive-widget=resizes-content">
  <meta name="color-scheme" content="dark">
  <meta name="theme-color" content="#071b1b">
  <meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data:; font-src data:; media-src data:; connect-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'">
  <title>Advanced Earthworm Dissection Laboratory v1.3.2-beta · HQ Atlas Edition</title>
  <style>
    :root{--bg:#061515;--panel:#0b2322;--panel2:#102e2c;--ink:#eef9f4;--muted:#b9d3cb;--line:#315d58;--teal:#38d6bc;--gold:#f4c65b;--danger:#ff54d7;--ok:#65df91;--focus:#fff08b;--organ:#f08b78;--vessel:#e74f5b;--nerve:#f7c84b;--excretory:#75d4d0;--repro:#cf8df4;--resp:#63c9ff;--shadow:0 16px 44px rgba(0,0,0,.32);font-family:Inter,system-ui,-apple-system,"Noto Sans Tamil","Nirmala UI",sans-serif}
    *{box-sizing:border-box}html{background:var(--bg);scroll-behavior:smooth}body{margin:0;color:var(--ink);background:radial-gradient(circle at 20% 0,#123b35 0,transparent 34%),linear-gradient(180deg,#061515,#081c1b 52%,#061515);min-height:100vh}
    button,select{font:inherit}button{color:inherit}.skip{position:fixed;left:.6rem;top:-5rem;z-index:100;padding:.7rem 1rem;background:#fff;color:#000;border-radius:.5rem}.skip:focus{top:.6rem}
    .app-header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:40;background:rgba(6,21,21,.94);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:max(.65rem,env(safe-area-inset-top)) clamp(.7rem,2vw,1.4rem) .65rem}
    .brand-row,.header-actions,.mode-row,.tabs,.tools,.stage-head,.stage-actions,.score-row,.step-actions,.detail-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.55rem;flex-wrap:wrap}.brand-row{justify-content:space-between}.brand h1{font-size:clamp(1.02rem,2.6vw,1.55rem);margin:0;letter-spacing:.01em}.brand p{margin:.14rem 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:.78rem}.badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;border:1px solid #52766f;border-radius:999px;padding:.2rem .48rem;color:#d9eee8;font-size:.7rem;background:#0d2926}
    .icon-btn,.seg-btn,.tool-btn,.primary-btn,.ghost-btn,.zoom-btn,.choice-btn{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#102d2b;border-radius:.72rem;min-height:42px;padding:.55rem .75rem;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .16s ease,background .16s,border-color .16s,box-shadow .16s}.icon-btn:hover,.seg-btn:hover,.tool-btn:hover,.ghost-btn:hover,.zoom-btn:hover,.choice-btn:hover{background:#17403c;border-color:#4d8279}.icon-btn:active,.seg-btn:active,.tool-btn:active,.primary-btn:active,.ghost-btn:active,.zoom-btn:active{transform:translateY(1px)}
    button:focus-visible,[tabindex="0"]:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:3px}.icon-btn[aria-pressed="true"],.seg-btn[aria-pressed="true"],.tool-btn[aria-pressed="true"]{background:#0e574d;border-color:var(--teal);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(56,214,188,.18)}.primary-btn{background:#16a98f;border-color:#37d7ba;color:#021310;font-weight:800}.ghost-btn{background:transparent}.danger-btn{border-color:#9b4d4d;color:#ffd4cf}.small{font-size:.79rem;min-height:36px;padding:.4rem .6rem}
    .top-nav{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:#091d1c;padding:.55rem clamp(.7rem,2vw,1.4rem)}.tabs{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;flex-wrap:nowrap;overflow-x:visible;overflow-y:auto;max-height:min(70vh,520px);scrollbar-width:thin;padding-bottom:.15rem}#systemTabs .seg-btn{white-space:nowrap;justify-content:flex-start;width:100%;flex:none}.seg-btn .sys-icon{font-size:1.05rem;margin-right:.28rem}
    .shell{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.65fr) minmax(310px,.75fr);gap:1rem;max-width:1600px;margin:0 auto;padding:1rem clamp(.65rem,2vw,1.25rem) 3rem}.card{background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(16,46,44,.96),rgba(8,29,28,.97));border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:1rem;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
    .stage-card{min-width:0;overflow:hidden}.stage-head{justify-content:space-between;padding:.78rem .9rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.stage-head h2{margin:0;font-size:1rem}.stage-head p{margin:.15rem 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:.75rem}.canvas-wrap{position:relative;overflow:hidden;touch-action:pan-y;background:linear-gradient(#0d2826,#071c1b);min-height:300px}.canvas-wrap.zoomed{touch-action:none}.canvas-wrap.grabbing{cursor:grabbing}.canvas-wrap svg{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;min-height:300px;transform-origin:0 0;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none}.zoom-dock{position:absolute;right:.65rem;bottom:.65rem;display:flex;gap:.32rem;background:rgba(3,15,14,.84);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:.8rem;padding:.35rem;z-index:5}.zoom-btn{min-width:40px;padding:.35rem .55rem;background:#153a36}.touch-label{position:absolute;left:50%;top:.65rem;translate:-50% 0;max-width:88%;padding:.45rem .7rem;border-radius:999px;background:#001b18e6;border:2px solid var(--teal);color:#fff;font-weight:800;font-size:.8rem;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transform:translateY(-8px);transition:.2s;z-index:7}.touch-label.show{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}
    .svg-structure{cursor:pointer;transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center;transition:filter .18s,transform .18s,opacity .18s}.svg-structure:hover,.svg-structure:focus-visible{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 7px rgba(255,240,139,.9));transform:scale(1.025)}.svg-structure.selected>*:not(.hit),.svg-structure.targeted>*:not(.hit){filter:drop-shadow(0 0 9px #fff08b);stroke:#fff08b!important;stroke-width:4!important}.svg-structure.selected{animation:selectPulse .9s ease 2}.hit{fill:transparent;stroke:transparent;pointer-events:all}.layer{display:none}.layer.active{display:inline}.segment-line{stroke:#f0c6a8;stroke-width:1;opacity:.28}.segment-shadow{stroke:#2a1210;stroke-width:1.4;opacity:.4}.organ-label{font-size:13px;font-weight:750;fill:#f6fff9;paint-order:stroke;stroke:#061515;stroke-width:4;stroke-linejoin:round;pointer-events:none}.micro-label{font-size:10px;fill:#e7f5ef;paint-order:stroke;stroke:#061515;stroke-width:3;pointer-events:none}.target-ring{fill:none;stroke:var(--focus);stroke-width:4;stroke-dasharray:7 5;animation:dash 1.1s linear infinite;pointer-events:none}.selection-ring{fill:rgba(56,214,188,.08);stroke:var(--teal);stroke-width:6;stroke-dasharray:none;animation:selectionPulse 1s ease-in-out 2;pointer-events:none}.flow{stroke-dasharray:12 8;animation:flow 1.4s linear infinite}.heart{animation:heart 1.25s ease-in-out infinite;transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center}.gas{stroke-dasharray:5 7;animation:flow 1.2s linear infinite}.flap{fill:#835d4f;stroke:#c18b74;stroke-width:2;opacity:.44}.action-guide{fill:none;stroke:#fff08b;stroke-width:5;stroke-dasharray:10 7;animation:dash 1s linear infinite}
    .procedure-panel{border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:linear-gradient(90deg,#102f2c,#0a201e);padding:.75rem .9rem}.procedure-panel[hidden]{display:none}.procedure-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:.8rem;align-items:center}.procedure-copy h3{margin:.2rem 0;font-size:.98rem}.procedure-copy p{margin:.25rem 0;color:#d5e9e3;font-size:.82rem;line-height:1.42}.procedure-copy .safety{color:#ffe3a2}.procedure-controls{display:flex;gap:.38rem;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end}.procedure-progress{height:.38rem;margin-top:.55rem}.procedure-active #layer-setup>.svg-structure,.procedure-active #layer-setup>path{opacity:.08;pointer-events:none}.procedure-demo{display:none}.procedure-active .procedure-demo{display:inline}.demo-element{opacity:0;transition:opacity .35s ease}.demo-element.revealed{opacity:1}.demo-landmark{opacity:.2;transition:opacity .3s}.procedure-demo[data-step="0"] .demo-landmark{opacity:1}.demo-pin{filter:drop-shadow(0 3px 3px #0008)}.demo-cut{stroke-dasharray:820;stroke-dashoffset:820}.procedure-demo.animate .demo-element.active{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 8px #fff08b)}.procedure-demo.animate[data-step="1"] .demo-pin-a{animation:pinDown .8s ease both}.procedure-demo.animate[data-step="2"] .demo-pin-p{animation:pinDown .8s ease both}.procedure-demo.animate[data-step="3"] .demo-cut{animation:drawCut 3.8s linear both}.procedure-demo.animate[data-step="3"] .demo-scissors{animation:scissorTravel 3.8s linear both}.procedure-demo.animate[data-step="3"] .demo-blade-a{animation:snipA .34s ease-in-out infinite alternate;transform-origin:0 0}.procedure-demo.animate[data-step="3"] .demo-blade-b{animation:snipB .34s ease-in-out infinite alternate;transform-origin:0 0}.procedure-demo.animate[data-step="4"] .demo-probe{animation:probeTravel 2.8s ease-in-out both}.procedure-demo.animate[data-step="4"] .demo-septa path{animation:septaRelease 2.8s linear both}.demo-flap-top,.demo-flap-bottom{transform-box:fill-box;transition:transform 1.2s ease,opacity .5s}.procedure-demo.opened .demo-skin{opacity:.12}.procedure-demo.opened .demo-flap-top{transform:translateY(-78px) rotate(-2deg)}.procedure-demo.opened .demo-flap-bottom{transform:translateY(78px) rotate(2deg)}.procedure-demo.animate[data-step="5"] .demo-forceps{animation:forcepsOpen 1.2s ease both}.procedure-demo[data-step="6"] .demo-open-label{opacity:1}.demo-open-label{opacity:0;transition:.35s}.demo-guard{fill:none;stroke:#5fd7ff;stroke-width:4;stroke-dasharray:8 7}.demo-vessel{fill:none;stroke:#ef5c65;stroke-width:9}.demo-organ{filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 3px #0008)}
    @keyframes dash{to{stroke-dashoffset:-24}}@keyframes flow{to{stroke-dashoffset:-40}}@keyframes heart{50%{transform:scale(1.13);filter:drop-shadow(0 0 5px #ff8d94)}}@keyframes selectPulse{50%{opacity:.76;transform:scale(1.04)}}@keyframes selectionPulse{50%{stroke-width:9;fill:rgba(56,214,188,.18)}}@keyframes pinDown{from{transform:translateY(-52px)}to{transform:translateY(0)}}@keyframes drawCut{to{stroke-dashoffset:0}}@keyframes scissorTravel{from{transform:translate(0,0)}to{transform:translate(-720px,-13px)}}@keyframes snipA{from{transform:rotate(-17deg)}to{transform:rotate(7deg)}}@keyframes snipB{from{transform:rotate(17deg)}to{transform:rotate(-7deg)}}@keyframes probeTravel{0%{transform:translateX(0)}50%{transform:translateX(450px)}100%{transform:translateX(760px)}}@keyframes septaRelease{0%{opacity:1}70%,100%{opacity:.12}}@keyframes forcepsOpen{from{transform:translateY(0)}to{transform:translateY(-55px)}}
    .tools-panel{padding:.75rem .85rem;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.tools-title{font-weight:800;font-size:.8rem;margin-bottom:.5rem}.tool-btn{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.25rem auto;align-items:center;gap:.35rem;padding:.48rem .6rem}.tool-btn span:first-child{font-size:1rem}.tool-btn[disabled]{opacity:.38;cursor:not-allowed}.orientation-switch{display:inline-flex;gap:.25rem;padding:.2rem;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:.75rem;background:#071b1a}.orientation-switch[hidden]{display:none}.orientation-switch .seg-btn{min-height:34px;padding:.32rem .52rem;font-size:.75rem}.external-view{display:none}.external-view.active{display:inline}.orientation-note{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;fill:#fff3c5;paint-order:stroke;stroke:#061515;stroke-width:4;pointer-events:none}
    .side{display:grid;gap:1rem;align-content:start}.mode-card,.instruction-card,.detail-card{padding:.85rem}.mode-row{margin-bottom:.75rem}.mode-row .seg-btn{flex:1}.score-row{justify-content:space-between;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:.65rem;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted)}progress{width:100%;height:.55rem;accent-color:var(--teal)}
    .eyebrow{text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--teal);font-size:.67rem;font-weight:850}.instruction-card h3,.detail-card h3{margin:.35rem 0;font-size:1.08rem}.instruction-card p,.detail-card p{color:#d6ebe4;line-height:1.48;margin:.45rem 0;font-size:.88rem}.step-meta{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:.5rem;margin:.65rem 0}.meta-box{padding:.55rem;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:.65rem;background:#071d1b}.meta-box b{display:block;color:var(--gold);font-size:.72rem;margin-bottom:.15rem}.meta-box span{font-size:.8rem}.feedback{min-height:48px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-left:4px solid var(--teal);border-radius:.65rem;padding:.6rem .7rem;background:#071b1a;font-size:.82rem;line-height:1.35;margin:.65rem 0}.feedback.error{border:2px dashed var(--danger);border-left:7px solid var(--danger);background:#34132f;animation:shake .32s}.feedback.error::before{content:"⚠ ";font-weight:900;color:var(--danger)}.feedback.success{border-color:#2d8150;border-left-color:var(--ok);animation:flash .45s}@keyframes shake{25%{transform:translateX(-3px)}75%{transform:translateX(3px)}}@keyframes flash{50%{background:#0e4930}}
    .detail-card dl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:max-content 1fr;gap:.38rem .65rem;margin:.6rem 0;font-size:.82rem}.detail-card dt{color:var(--gold);font-weight:800}.detail-card dd{margin:0;color:#d9ebe5}.correction{border-left:3px solid var(--gold);padding:.55rem .65rem;background:#30291388;border-radius:.35rem;font-size:.8rem;color:#fff3cc}.empty-state{text-align:center;padding:1.2rem .5rem;color:var(--muted)}
    .assessment{display:none}.assessment.active{display:block}.question{font-weight:750;line-height:1.45;margin:.6rem 0}.choices{display:grid;gap:.5rem}.choice-btn{text-align:left;background:#0a2523}.choice-btn.correct{border-color:var(--ok);background:#114b31}.choice-btn.wrong{border-color:var(--danger);background:#512725}.choice-btn:disabled{cursor:default}.certificate{padding:1.2rem;margin-top:.8rem;border:4px double #f4c65b;border-radius:.8rem;background:radial-gradient(circle,#173d36,#081b1a);text-align:center}.certificate h3{font-family:Georgia,serif;color:#ffe19a;font-size:1.5rem}.certificate .seal{font-size:2.4rem}.certificate p{margin:.35rem}.certificate .score{font-size:1.2rem;font-weight:900;color:var(--ok)}
    dialog{color:var(--ink);background:#0b2422;border:1px solid #4f7b73;border-radius:1rem;box-shadow:0 24px 80px #000c;max-width:min(720px,94vw);width:100%;padding:0}dialog::backdrop{background:#00110fd9;backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}.dialog-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:.8rem 1rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.dialog-head h2{margin:0;font-size:1rem}.dialog-body{padding:1rem}.micro-card{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(210px,1fr) 1fr;gap:1rem}.micro-card svg{width:100%;height:auto;background:#071918;border-radius:.75rem;border:1px solid var(--line)}.close-x{border:0;background:transparent;color:#fff;font-size:1.4rem;cursor:pointer}
    .reference-strip{max-width:1600px;margin:0 auto 2rem;padding:0 clamp(.65rem,2vw,1.25rem);display:grid;gap:.65rem}details.ref{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:.8rem;background:#0a211f;padding:.7rem .85rem}details.ref summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:800}.ref p,.ref li,.ref td,.ref th{font-size:.8rem;line-height:1.5}.ref p,.ref li,.ref td{color:var(--muted)}.ref-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin:.65rem 0;display:table}.ref-table th,.ref-table td{border:1px solid .4rem;color:var(--gold)}.review-actions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:.45rem;margin-top:.65rem}.review-card{padding:.7rem;border:1px solid .45rem;border-radius:999px;background:#183f3a;color:#aef4e6;font-size:.66rem;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:.45rem}.match-table{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:.35rem;margin:.45rem 0}.match-table div{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:.45rem;padding:.42rem;background:#071b1a;font-size:.75rem;line-height:1.35}.voice-warning,.storage-warning{display:none;padding:.5rem .8rem;font-size:.78rem;text-align:center}.storage-warning{background:#4b3218;color:#ffe9bc;border-bottom:1px solid #9e763b}.voice-warning{background:#301d4d;color:#f4ddff;border-bottom:1px solid #9a6ec4}.voice-warning.show,.storage-warning.show{display:block}.footer{text-align:center;color:#9fbeb5;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:1rem .7rem calc(1rem + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));font-size:.72rem}.footer strong{color:#d8eee7}.sr-only{position:absolute!important;width:1px!important;height:1px!important;padding:0!important;margin:-1px!important;overflow:hidden!important;clip:rect(0,0,0,0)!important;white-space:nowrap!important;border:0!important}
    .high-contrast{--bg:#000;--panel:#07120f;--panel2:#0b1c18;--ink:#fff;--muted:#e8f5ef;--line:#8ac5b7;--teal:#54ffdf;--gold:#ffe36c}.high-contrast .canvas-wrap svg{filter:contrast(1.15) saturate(1.15)}
    @media(max-width:980px){.shell{grid-template-columns:1fr}.side{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.detail-card{grid-column:1/-1}}
    @media(max-width:640px){.app-header{position:relative}.header-actions{width:100%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}.icon-btn{padding:.46rem .35rem;font-size:.75rem}.shell{padding-top:.65rem}.side{grid-template-columns:1fr}.detail-card{grid-column:auto}.canvas-wrap{min-height:0;aspect-ratio:15/7}.canvas-wrap svg{width:100%;max-width:100%;min-width:0;height:auto;min-height:0}.zoom-dock{right:.4rem;bottom:.4rem}.micro-card{grid-template-columns:1fr}.brand-row{align-items:flex-start}.step-actions>*{flex:1}.tools{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}.tool-btn{font-size:.73rem;min-width:0}.tool-btn span:last-child{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.stage-head{align-items:flex-start}.procedure-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.procedure-controls{justify-content:stretch;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}.procedure-controls button{padding:.42rem .3rem;min-width:0}.stage-actions{width:100%}.ref-table{display:block;overflow-x:auto}.review-actions,.match-table{grid-template-columns:1fr}.svg-structure .hit{stroke:transparent!important;stroke-width:64px!important}}
    @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*::before,*::after{animation-duration:.001ms!important;animation-iteration-count:1!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important;transition-duration:.001ms!important}}
    @media print{@page{size:landscape;margin:10mm}body{background:#fff;color:#000}.app-header,.top-nav,.shell,.reference-strip,.footer{display:none}.certificate{display:block!important;color:#000;background:#fff;border-color:#795d00;max-width:800px;margin:2rem auto}.certificate *{color:#000!important}body.print-certificate .shell{display:block!important;max-width:900px;padding:0;margin:0 auto}body.print-certificate .stage-card,body.print-certificate .mode-card,body.print-certificate .detail-card{display:none!important}body.print-certificate .side{display:block!important}body.print-certificate #instructionCard{display:block!important;border:0;box-shadow:none;background:#fff;padding:0}body.print-certificate #instructionCard>*:not(.certificate){display:none!important}body.print-atlas .shell{display:block!important;max-width:none;padding:0}body.print-atlas .stage-card{display:block!important;border:0;box-shadow:none;background:#fff}body.print-atlas .stage-head{display:flex;color:#000}body.print-atlas .stage-actions,body.print-atlas .zoom-dock,body.print-atlas .tools-panel,body.print-atlas .side,body.print-atlas .procedure-panel{display:none!important}body.print-atlas .canvas-wrap{display:block!important;background:#fff;overflow:visible}body.print-atlas #anatomySvg{transform:none!important;width:100%!important;height:auto!important;filter:none!important}body.print-atlas .layer.active{display:inline!important}body.print-atlas .organ-label,body.print-atlas .micro-label{stroke:#fff;fill:#000}body.print-atlas #touchLabel{display:none}}

    /* v1.3: compact navigation and stable, light scientific plates. */
    a{color:#9cf0df;text-underline-offset:.2em}select{max-width:100%;min-width:0;min-height:44px;background:#092a25;color:#f3fff9;border:1px solid #679e8d;border-radius:.6rem;padding:.45rem .6rem;font:inherit}
    select:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:2px}.mobile-system{display:none}
    .tabs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));max-height:none;overflow:visible}
    #systemTabs .seg-btn{white-space:normal;text-align:left;font-size:.86rem;min-height:44px}
    .plate-controls{display:flex;gap:.45rem;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:.65rem .8rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:.8rem}.plate-controls #structureSelect{flex:1;min-width:160px}.plate-controls label{color:var(--muted)}
    .plate-note{margin:0;padding:.55rem .85rem;color:#f1deb0;font-size:.78rem;line-height:1.4;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
    .module-navigation{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:.8rem;max-width:1560px;margin:0 auto 1rem;padding:0 1rem}
    .canvas-wrap{overscroll-behavior:contain}.canvas-wrap svg{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,#18372f,#081f1b)}
    .svg-structure:hover,.svg-structure:focus-visible{transform:none;filter:none}
    .svg-structure.selected,.svg-structure.targeted{animation:none}
    .svg-structure.selected>*:not(.hit):not(text),.svg-structure.targeted>*:not(.hit):not(text){filter:drop-shadow(0 0 3px #fff08b);stroke:#fff08b!important;stroke-width:3!important}
    .svg-structure.selected>text,.svg-structure.targeted>text{filter:none;stroke:#061515!important;stroke-width:3!important;fill:#fff6c7}
    .svg-structure .hit{stroke-width:12px!important}.organ-label{font-size:16px;font-weight:700;stroke-width:3}.micro-label{font-size:13px;stroke-width:3}
    .motion-paused *, .layer:not(.active) *{animation-play-state:paused!important}
    .motion-paused *{transition:none!important}.motion-paused .demo-cut{stroke-dashoffset:0!important}
    @keyframes heart{50%{stroke-width:9;transform:none;filter:none}}
    .light-render .texture-overlay{display:none}.app-header{backdrop-filter:none}
    .close-x,.small,.zoom-btn,.tool-btn{min-height:44px}.close-x{min-width:44px}
    #detailCard{scroll-margin-top:1rem}.detail-card dl{grid-template-columns:1fr}.detail-card dt{margin-top:.25rem}.detail-card dd{line-height:1.55}
    @media(max-width:980px){.shell{gap:.6rem}.side{display:contents}.mode-card{grid-row:1}.stage-card{grid-row:2}.instruction-card{grid-row:3}.detail-card{grid-row:4}.mode-row{margin:.3rem 0}.score-row{padding-top:.3rem}.shell{padding-bottom:1rem}}
    @media(max-width:640px){.top-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem}.mobile-system{display:block}.mobile-system#systemSelectLabel{font-size:.75rem;color:var(--muted);max-width:90px}#systemSelect{flex:1}#systemTabs{display:none}.plate-controls{gap:.4rem}.plate-controls #structureLabel{width:100%}.plate-controls #structureSelect{width:100%;flex-basis:100%}.plate-controls select,.plate-controls button{font-size:.8rem}.stage-actions{gap:.35rem}.stage-head{padding:.6rem}.canvas-wrap{aspect-ratio:15/8}.canvas-wrap svg{height:100%;width:100%}.plate-note{font-size:.75rem}.texture-overlay{display:none}.organ-label{font-size:16px}.header-actions .icon-btn{min-height:44px}.tools{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.tool-btn span:last-child{white-space:normal;overflow:visible}.mode-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.mode-row .seg-btn{font-size:.82rem}.module-navigation button{flex:1;font-size:.85rem}}
    @media print{.plate-controls,.plate-note,.module-navigation,.mobile-system{display:none!important}.texture-overlay{display:none}.organ-label,.micro-label{fill:#111;stroke:#fff}.canvas-wrap svg{background:#fff}}

    :lang(ta){font-family:"Earthworm Tamil","Noto Sans Tamil","Nirmala UI",sans-serif;letter-spacing:normal;text-transform:none;word-break:normal;hyphens:none}
    html[data-lang="ta"] body{line-height:1.7}
    html[data-lang="ta"] :is(h1,h2,h3,h4,button,select){line-height:1.55}
    html[data-lang="ta"] :is(p,dd,li,td,th,.feedback,.correction,.match-table div){line-height:1.8}
    html[data-lang="ta"] :is(.eyebrow,.brand h1){letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none}
    html[data-lang="ta"] :is(.eyebrow,.badge,.question-type){font-size:.8rem;font-weight:600}
    html[data-lang="ta"] :is(.small,.brand p,.stage-head p,.meta-box span,.score-row,.plate-note,.footer,.ref p,.ref li,.ref td,.ref th,.correction,.detail-card dl,.feedback,.procedure-copy p){font-size:.9rem}
    html[data-lang="ta"] .detail-card dd{font-size:1rem}
    html[data-lang="ta"] .certificate h3{font-family:"Earthworm Tamil",sans-serif}
    html[data-lang="ta"] :is(.seg-btn,.icon-btn,.tool-btn){white-space:normal;min-width:0}
    html[data-lang="ta"] #systemTabs .seg-btn{white-space:normal}
    html[data-lang="ta"] svg text{letter-spacing:0;font-family:"Earthworm Tamil","Noto Sans Tamil",sans-serif}
    html[data-lang="ta"] .touch-label{border-radius:.7rem;line-height:1.65}
    .voice-controls{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.55rem;align-items:center;padding:.65rem .85rem;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
    .voice-controls label{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--muted)}
    .voice-controls select{min-width:0;max-width:100%;flex:1 1 220px;background:#0a2523;color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:.6rem;padding:.6rem}
    .voice-help{flex-basis:100%;margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:.85rem;line-height:1.65}
    @media(max-width:640px){html[data-lang="ta"] .header-actions{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}html[data-lang="ta"] .procedure-controls{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}html[data-lang="ta"] .mode-row .seg-btn{font-size:.9rem}html[data-lang="ta"] .step-meta{grid-template-columns:1fr}html[data-lang="ta"] .plate-controls :is(button,select){font-size:.88rem}html[data-lang="ta"] .stage-actions{align-items:stretch}.voice-controls label{flex-basis:100%}.voice-controls select{flex-basis:100%}}
    @media print{.voice-controls{display:none!important}}

    /* v1.3.2: surface shading uses SVG strokes/gradients, without new blur or texture filters. */
    .surface-detail{pointer-events:none}
    .svg-structure.selected>text,.svg-structure.targeted>text{fill:#fffbe5;stroke:#061515!important;stroke-width:3!important;filter:none!important}
    .procedure-active #layer-setup>text,.procedure-active #layer-setup>.svg-structure text{display:none}
    .procedure-demo:not([data-step="3"]) .demo-scissors,.procedure-demo:not([data-step="4"]) .demo-probe,.procedure-demo:not([data-step="5"]) .demo-forceps{display:none}
    .procedure-demo.opened .demo-landmark,.procedure-demo.opened .demo-cut{display:none}
    .demo-open-orientation{display:none}.procedure-demo.opened .demo-open-orientation{display:inline}
    .plate-caption .organ-label,.plate-caption .micro-label{fill:#f1faf5;stroke:#082923;stroke-width:2}
    .svg-structure.selected .surface-detail,.svg-structure.targeted .surface-detail{filter:none!important;stroke-width:inherit}
    @media print{.plate-caption rect{fill:#fff;stroke:#777}.plate-caption .organ-label,.plate-caption .micro-label{fill:#111;stroke:#fff}.svg-structure.selected>text,.svg-structure.targeted>text{fill:#111;stroke:#fff!important}}

    /* HQ Atlas integration: raster plates complement — never replace — the interactive SVG layer. */
    .hq-atlas-panel{border-top:1px solid var(--line);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#071d1b,#0a2522);padding:.85rem .9rem 1rem}
    .hq-atlas-panel[hidden]{display:none}.hq-atlas-head{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:.75rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:.65rem}
    .hq-atlas-title-wrap{min-width:0}.hq-atlas-kicker{font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--teal);font-weight:850;margin-bottom:.18rem}
    .hq-atlas-title{margin:0;font-size:1rem;color:#fff}.hq-atlas-meta{font-size:.72rem;color:var(--muted);margin-top:.2rem}
    .hq-atlas-figure{margin:0;border:1px solid #3e6962;border-radius:.9rem;overflow:hidden;background:#031513;box-shadow:0 16px 34px #0006}
    .hq-atlas-image{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:4/3;object-fit:contain;background:#032421;cursor:zoom-in;image-rendering:auto}
    .hq-atlas-caption{margin:0;padding:.7rem .8rem;color:#d9eee8;background:#071b19;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:.78rem;line-height:1.5}
    .hq-atlas-caption strong{color:var(--gold)}.hq-atlas-caution{display:block;margin-top:.35rem;color:#ffe0a3}
    .hq-atlas-dialog{max-width:min(96vw,2100px);width:96vw;max-height:94vh}.hq-atlas-dialog .dialog-body{padding:.55rem;overflow:auto;max-height:calc(94vh - 64px);background:#02110f}
    .hq-atlas-dialog img{display:block;width:auto;max-width:none;height:auto;min-width:min(100%,900px);margin:auto;background:#032421}
    @media(max-width:640px){.hq-atlas-panel{padding:.65rem}.hq-atlas-head{align-items:stretch}.hq-atlas-head .ghost-btn{width:100%}.hq-atlas-caption{font-size:.76rem}.hq-atlas-dialog img{width:100%;min-width:100%;max-width:100%}}
    @media print{.hq-atlas-panel{display:none!important}.hq-atlas-dialog{display:none!important}}

<body>
  <a id="skipLink" class="skip" href="#main">Skip to simulator</a>
  <div id="storageWarning" class="storage-warning" role="status"></div>
  <div id="voiceWarning" class="voice-warning" role="status"></div>
  <header class="app-header">
    <div class="brand-row">
      <div class="brand">
        <h1 id="appTitle">Advanced Earthworm Dissection Laboratory</h1>
        <p id="appSubtitle"><i>Metaphire posthuma</i> (syn. <i>Pheretima posthuma</i>) · anatomy and mobile revision v1.3.2-beta</p>
      </div>
      <div class="header-actions" aria-label="Application controls">
        <button id="langBtn" class="icon-btn" type="button" aria-label="Change language">EN</button>
        <button id="soundBtn" class="icon-btn" type="button" aria-pressed="true">🔊 <span data-ui="sound">Sound</span></button>
        <button id="voiceBtn" class="icon-btn" type="button" aria-pressed="true">🗣 <span data-ui="voice">Voice</span></button>
        <button id="contrastBtn" class="icon-btn" type="button" aria-pressed="false">◐ <span data-ui="contrast">Contrast</span></button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </header>
  <nav id="systemNav" class="top-nav" aria-label="Anatomical systems">
    <label class="mobile-system" for="systemSelect" id="systemSelectLabel">Anatomical system</label><select class="mobile-system" id="systemSelect"></select><div id="systemTabs" class="tabs"></div>
  </nav>

  <main id="main" class="shell">
    <section class="stage-card card" aria-labelledby="stageTitle">
      <div class="stage-head">
        <div><h2 id="stageTitle" tabindex="-1">Dissection tray</h2><p id="stageHint">Select a system and follow the protocol.</p></div>
        <div class="stage-actions"><span id="specimenBadge" class="badge">Adult specimen · dorsal dissection</span><div id="externalViewControls" class="orientation-switch" role="group" aria-label="External surface" hidden><button class="seg-btn" type="button" data-external-view="dorsal" aria-pressed="true">Dorsal</button><button class="seg-btn" type="button" data-external-view="ventral" aria-pressed="false">Ventral</button></div><button id="procedureBtn" type="button" class="primary-btn small" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="procedurePanel">▶ <span id="procedureBtnText">Graphical procedure</span></button><button id="printAtlasBtn" type="button" class="ghost-btn small">🖨 <span id="printAtlasText">Labelled diagram</span></button><button id="resetBtn" type="button" class="ghost-btn small danger-btn">↺ <span data-ui="reset">Reset</span></button></div>
      </div>
      <div class="plate-controls"><label id="structureLabel" for="structureSelect">Choose a structure</label><select id="structureSelect"></select><button id="animationBtn" class="ghost-btn small" type="button" aria-pressed="true">Animation</button><label for="speechRate" id="rateLabel">Voice speed</label><select id="speechRate"><option value="0.8">0.8×</option><option value="0.9">0.9×</option><option value="1">1×</option></select><button id="stopVoiceBtn" class="ghost-btn small" type="button">Stop voice</button></div><div class="voice-controls"><label for="voiceSelect" id="voiceSelectLabel">Narration voice</label><select id="voiceSelect" aria-describedby="voiceHelp"></select><button class="ghost-btn small" type="button" id="voiceSampleBtn">Listen to a sample</button><p id="voiceHelp" class="voice-help"></p></div><p id="plateNote" class="plate-note"></p><div id="canvasWrap" class="canvas-wrap">
        <div id="touchLabel" class="touch-label" aria-hidden="true"></div>
        <svg id="anatomySvg" viewBox="0 0 1200 560" role="group" aria-labelledby="svgTitle svgDesc">
          <title id="svgTitle">Interactive earthworm dissection diagram</title>
          <desc id="svgDesc">A stylized dorsal dissection view of Metaphire posthuma with selectable organ systems.</desc>
          <defs>
            <linearGradient id="trayGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop stop-color="#173e3b"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#071b1a"/></linearGradient>
            <linearGradient id="skinGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop stop-color="#b87f69"/><stop offset=".42" stop-color="#8b5b4b"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#593c35"/></linearGradient>
            <linearGradient id="gutGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop stop-color="#ffd0aa"/><stop offset=".5" stop-color="#d37e66"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#7e3d3f"/></linearGradient>
            <linearGradient id="gutLight" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop stop-color="#ffe4bb"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#c67c57"/></linearGradient>
            <radialGradient id="gizzardGrad"><stop stop-color="#f4c099"/><stop offset=".58" stop-color="#b36454"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#683940"/></radialGradient>
            <linearGradient id="vesselGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0"><stop stop-color="#8e1e34"/><stop offset=".45" stop-color="#ff6670"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#8e1e34"/></linearGradient>
            <radialGradient id="reproGrad"><stop stop-color="#f3c8ff"/><stop offset=".7" stop-color="#a958c6"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#54295f"/></radialGradient>

            <radialGradient id="glossHiSmall" cx="30%" cy="22%" r="70%"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#fff" stop-opacity=".7"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#fff" stop-opacity="0"/></radialGradient>

            <radialGradient id="fleshGlow" cx="50%" cy="35%" r="65%"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#ffe0c8" stop-opacity=".5"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#ffe0c8" stop-opacity="0"/></radialGradient>
          <clipPath id="externalClip"><path d="M65 280 C88 227 136 190 220 186 C470 180 841 183 1050 208 C1112 217 1140 245 1145 280 C1138 324 1095 350 1044 358 C784 384 420 377 218 374 C133 371 87 330 65 280 Z"/></clipPath><linearGradient id="caecumPolish" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#ffe1b5"/><stop offset="0.33" stop-color="#efb082"/><stop offset="0.68" stop-color="#bb715f"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#663940"/></linearGradient><linearGradient id="nervePolish" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#fff3c1"/><stop offset="0.28" stop-color="#ffe179"/><stop offset="0.65" stop-color="#d8a43a"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#805424"/></linearGradient><linearGradient id="epidermisPolish" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#f8ccad"/><stop offset="0.4" stop-color="#d99c80"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#8f594f"/></linearGradient><linearGradient id="skinDepthPolish" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#b77d6c"/><stop offset="0.55" stop-color="#734e48"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#382e32"/></linearGradient><linearGradient id="mucusPolish" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#e6fcff"/><stop offset="0.28" stop-color="#ade4e5"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#487f89"/></linearGradient><radialGradient id="ganglionPolish" cx=".33" cy=".22" r=".85"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#fff8d2"/><stop offset="0.38" stop-color="#f7d565"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#957026"/></radialGradient><marker id="arrowGasIn" markerWidth="12" markerHeight="12" refX="10" refY="6" orient="auto" markerUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><path d="M0 0L12 6L0 12Z" fill="#85e2ff"/></marker><marker id="arrowGasOut" markerWidth="12" markerHeight="12" refX="10" refY="6" orient="auto" markerUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><path d="M0 0L12 6L0 12Z" fill="#ffb0b7"/></marker></defs>
          <rect x="12" y="12" width="1176" height="536" rx="26" fill="url(#trayGrad)" stroke="#3e716a" stroke-width="2"/>
          <ellipse cx="600" cy="297" rx="526" ry="155" fill="#000" opacity=".28" filter="url(#soft)" id="bodyShadow"/>
          <path id="bodyBase" d="M62 280C80 201 132 160 222 151C402 133 802 137 1017 162C1084 170 1131 216 1143 279C1130 347 1081 388 1008 398C785 424 389 420 216 403C126 394 78 354 62 280Z" fill="#311f1e" stroke="#cb9278" stroke-width="5"/>
          <g id="segments" aria-hidden="true"/>

          <g id="layer-setup" class="layer active">
            <path d="M62 280C80 201 132 160 222 151C402 133 802 137 1017 162C1084 170 1131 216 1143 279C1130 347 1081 388 1008 398C785 424 389 420 216 403C126 394 78 354 62 280Z" fill="url(#skinGrad2)" stroke="#d99872" stroke-width="4"/><path d="M62 280C80 201 132 160 222 151C402 133 802 137 1017 162C1084 170 1131 216 1143 279C1130 347 1081 388 1008 398C785 424 389 420 216 403C126 394 78 354 62 280Z" fill="#1c0f0e" filter="url(#organicTexture)" opacity=".38" style="mix-blend-mode:multiply;pointer-events:none" class="texture-overlay"/><path d="M62 280C80 201 132 160 222 151C402 133 802 137 1017 162C1084 170 1131 216 1143 279C1130 347 1081 388 1008 398C785 424 389 420 216 403C126 394 78 354 62 280Z" fill="#000" filter="url(#fineGrain)" opacity=".12" style="mix-blend-mode:overlay;pointer-events:none" class="texture-overlay"/><ellipse cx="330" cy="205" rx="430" ry="72" fill="url(#glossHi)" style="mix-blend-mode:soft-light;pointer-events:none" opacity=".2" clip-path="url(#externalClip)"/><ellipse cx="860" cy="230" rx="220" ry="46" fill="url(#glossHiSmall)" opacity=".2" style="mix-blend-mode:soft-light;pointer-events:none" clip-path="url(#externalClip)"/>

    const REFERENCE_CONTENT={
      en:{
        taxonomy:`<div class="reference-grid"><div class="reference-box"><h4>Current placement</h4><p>Kingdom Animalia → Phylum Annelida → Class Clitellata → Subclass Oligochaeta → Order Crassiclitellata → Family Megascolecidae → Genus <i>Metaphire</i> → <i>Metaphire posthuma</i> (Vaillant, 1868).</p></div><div class="reference-box"><h4>Teaching-name note</h4><p><i>Pheretima posthuma</i> remains common in Indian practical manuals. Some databases and traditional schemes use Opisthopora at the order level. The simulator retains the familiar synonym but uses the accepted genus <i>Metaphire</i>.</p></div></div>`,
        advanced:`<div class="reference-grid"><div class="reference-box"><h4>Body wall and coelom</h4><p>Outside inward: cuticle → epidermis → circular muscle → longitudinal muscle → peritoneum → coelom. Septa compartmentalise the fluid-filled coelom, which functions as a hydrostatic skeleton and contains defence-associated coelomocytes.</p></div><div class="reference-box"><h4>Peristaltic locomotion</h4><p>Circular-muscle contraction elongates and narrows a segment; longitudinal-muscle contraction shortens and thickens it. Setae alternately anchor regions while coordinated waves pass along the body.</p></div><div class="reference-box"><h4>Cocoon formation</h4><p>After reciprocal sperm exchange, the clitellum secretes a mucous/albuminous girdle. As it moves anteriorly it receives ova and stored partner sperm; fertilisation and early development occur within the shed cocoon.</p></div><div class="reference-box"><h4>Regeneration—not asexual reproduction</h4><p>Earthworms can show wound repair and species-/position-dependent segment regeneration. A fragment is not automatically a new worm. Budding, fission and routine fragmentation are not normal reproductive modes of <i>M. posthuma</i>.</p></div><div class="reference-box"><h4>Nephridial classification</h4><p><b>Position:</b> pharyngeal, septal and integumentary. These are numerous micronephridia; septal nephridia are larger than the integumentary forms but are not the paired <i>Lumbricus</i>-type meganephridia. <b>Discharge:</b> septal and pharyngeal systems are enteronephric; integumentary nephridia are exonephric.</p></div></div>`,
        comparison:`<table class="ref-table"><thead><tr><th>Character</th><th><i>Metaphire posthuma</i></th><th>Common <i>Lumbricus terrestris</i> teaching account</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Family</td><td>Megascolecidae</td><td>Lumbricidae</td></tr><tr><td>Setae</td><td>Perichaetine: numerous around most segments</td><td>Lumbricine: eight setae in four pairs per typical segment</td></tr><tr><td>Clitellum</td><td>XIV–XVI; annular</td><td>Usually XXXII–XXXVII; saddle-shaped</td></tr><tr><td>Male pores</td><td>Paired on XVIII</td><td>Paired on XV</td></tr><tr><td>Spermathecae</td><td>Four pairs, VI–IX; pores 5/6–8/9</td><td>Two pairs associated with IX–X; openings near 9/10 and 10/11</td></tr><tr><td>Contractile arches</td><td>Four pairs: VII, IX, XII, XIII</td><td>Five pairs commonly illustrated: VII–XI</td></tr><tr><td>Taxonomic caution</td><td>Asian pheretimoid teaching specimen</td><td>European lumbricid; positions must not be transferred to <i>Metaphire</i></td></tr></tbody></table>`,

      ta:{
        taxonomy:`<div class="reference-grid"><div class="reference-box"><h4>தற்போதைய வகைப்பாட்டு நிலை</h4><p>விலங்கு உலகம் → வளையப்புழுக்கள் (Annelida) → கிளைட்டெல்லாட்டா → ஒலிகோகீட்டா → கிராசிகிளைட்டெல்லாட்டா → மெகாஸ்கோலிசிடே → <i>Metaphire</i> → <i>Metaphire posthuma</i> (Vaillant, 1868).</p></div><div class="reference-box"><h4>பாடப்பெயர்க் குறிப்பு</h4><p><i>Pheretima posthuma</i> என்ற பழைய பெயர் இந்தியச் செய்முறை நூல்களில் இன்னும் பரவலாக உள்ளது. சில தரவுத்தளங்களும் மரபுவழி முறைகளும் Opisthopora-வை வரிசையாகக் காட்டுகின்றன. இச்செயலி ஏற்றுக்கொள்ளப்பட்ட <i>Metaphire</i> பேரினப் பெயரையும் பழக்கமான இணைப்பெயரையும் வழங்குகிறது.</p></div></div>`,
        advanced:`<div class="reference-grid"><div class="reference-box"><h4>உடற்சுவரும் உடற்குழியும்</h4><p>வெளியிலிருந்து உள்ளாக: கியூட்டிக்கிள் → புறத்தோல் → வட்டத் தசை → நீளவாட்டுத் தசை → பெரிட்டோனியம் → உடற்குழி. இடைத்திரைகள் திரவம் நிறைந்த உடற்குழியை கண்டவாரியாகப் பிரிக்கின்றன; இது நீரழுத்த எலும்புக்கூடாகவும் பாதுகாப்புச் செல்களின் தளமாகவும் செயல்படுகிறது.</p></div><div class="reference-box"><h4>அலைபோன்ற இயக்கம்</h4><p>வட்டத் தசைச் சுருக்கம் கண்டத்தை நீளச்செய்து மெலியச் செய்கிறது; நீளவாட்டுத் தசைச் சுருக்கம் கண்டத்தைக் குறுகச் செய்து தடிப்பாக்குகிறது. சீட்டாக்கள் மாறிமாறிப் பகுதிகளைப் பற்றும் போது ஒருங்கிணைந்த சுருக்க அலைகள் உடலெங்கும் செல்கின்றன.</p></div><div class="reference-box"><h4>முட்டைக்கூடு உருவாக்கம்</h4><p>இருதரப்பு விந்தணுப் பரிமாற்றத்திற்குப் பின் கிளைட்டெல்லம் சளி–அல்புமின் வளையத்தைச் சுரக்கிறது. அது முன்நோக்கி நகரும் போது அண்டங்களையும் சேமித்த பிறவிந்தணுக்களையும் பெறுகிறது; கழன்று உருவாகும் முட்டைக்கூட்டினுள் கருவுறுதலும் தொடக்க வளர்ச்சியும் நடைபெறுகின்றன.</p></div><div class="reference-box"><h4>மீளுருவாக்கம்—பாலிலா இனப்பெருக்கம் அல்ல</h4><p>மண்புழுக்களில் காயம் ஆறுதலும், இனம் மற்றும் வெட்டிடம் சார்ந்த சில கண்ட மீளுருவாக்கமும் நிகழலாம். ஒவ்வொரு துண்டும் புதிய மண்புழுவாகாது. மொட்டுவிடுதல், இருபிளவு, வழக்கமான துண்டாதல் ஆகியவை <i>M. posthuma</i>-வின் இயல்பான இனப்பெருக்க முறைகள் அல்ல.</p></div><div class="reference-box"><h4>நெஃப்ரிடிய வகைப்பாடு</h4><p><b>அமைவிடம்:</b> தொண்டை, இடைத்திரை, உடற்சுவர். இவை அனைத்தும் அதிக எண்ணிக்கையிலான மைக்ரோநெஃப்ரிடியாக்கள். இடைத்திரை நெஃப்ரிடியாக்கள் உடற்சுவர் வகையைவிடப் பெரியவை; எனினும் அவை <i>Lumbricus</i>-இல் காணப்படும் ஓரிணை மேகாநெஃப்ரிடியாக்கள் அல்ல. <b>வெளியேற்றம்:</b> இடைத்திரை மற்றும் தொண்டை மண்டலங்கள் என்டெரோநெஃப்ரிக்; உடற்சுவர் நெஃப்ரிடியாக்கள் எக்சோநெஃப்ரிக்.</p></div></div>`,

      {enTitle:"Anchor the anterior end",taTitle:"முன்முனையை நிலைநிறுத்துதல்",en:"Insert the first pin obliquely just behind the prostomium.       {enTitle:"Extend and pin the posterior end",taTitle:"பின்முனையை நிலைநிறுத்துதல்",en:"Gently extend the specimen without overstretching the segments, then anchor the posterior end with a second oblique pin.",ta:"உடற்கண்டங்களை அதிகமாக இழுக்காமல், மாதிரியை மெதுவாக நீட்டவும். இரண்டாவது ஊசியைச் சாய்வாகச் செலுத்திப் பின்முனையை நிலைநிறுத்தவும்."},
      {enTitle:"Make a shallow dorsolateral incision",taTitle:"முதுகின் பக்கவாட்டில் ஆழமின்றி வெட்டுதல்",en:"Lift a small fold of body wall with forceps. Begin in the posterior region and advance anteriorly, slightly lateral to the dorsal midline.       {enTitle:"Release the intersegmental septa",taTitle:"இடைக்கண்டத் திரைகளைப் பிரித்தல்",en:"Use a blunt probe and fine scissors to separate septa close to the inner body wall. Never pull across the gut, hearts, reproductive organs or nerve cord.",ta:"மழுங்கிய ஆய்வூசியையும் நுண் கத்தரிக்கோலையும் பயன்படுத்தவும். உடற்சுவரின் உட்பரப்புக்கு அருகில் இடைத்திரைகளை மெதுவாகப் பிரிக்கவும். குடல், இதய வளைவுகள், இனப்பெருக்க உறுப்புகள், நரம்புவடம் ஆகியவற்றின் குறுக்கே இழுக்க வேண்டாம்."},
      {enTitle:"Reflect the body-wall flaps",taTitle:"உடற்சுவர் மடல்களைத் திறத்தல்",en:"Open the flaps gradually with forceps. Keep the specimen moist with physiological saline or clean water appropriate to the teaching protocol; do not flood before the incision is controlled.",ta:"இடுக்கியால் உடற்சுவர் மடல்களை மெதுவாகப் பக்கவாட்டில் திறக்கவும். செய்முறை வழிமுறைக்கு ஏற்ற உடலியல் உப்புநீரையோ தூய நீரையோ பயன்படுத்தி மாதிரியை ஈரமாக வைத்திருக்கவும். வெட்டுப் பகுதியைச் சீராகத் திறப்பதற்கு முன் அதிக திரவத்தை ஊற்ற வேண்டாம்."},
      {enTitle:"Pin the flaps and inspect the intact organs",taTitle:"உள்ளுறுப்புகளை அடையாளம் காணுதல்",en:"Pin each flap at a shallow outward angle. Add enough fluid to prevent drying, then identify the alimentary canal and dorsal vessel before exposing deeper systems.",ta:"மடல்களில் ஊசிகளை வெளிநோக்கிச் சாய்வாகச் செலுத்தி நிலைநிறுத்தவும். மாதிரி உலராமல் இருக்கத் தேவையான அளவு திரவத்தைச் சேர்க்கவும். ஆழத்தில் உள்ள மண்டலங்களைப் பார்ப்பதற்கு முன், உணவுப்பாதையையும் முதுகுப்புற இரத்த நாளத்தையும் அடையாளம் காணவும்."}
